text: And Dawiḏ and the commanders of the army separated for the service some of the sons of Asaph, and of Hĕman, and of Yeḏuthun, who should prophesy with lyres, with harps, and with cymbals. And the number of the workmen according to their service was:
Of the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, and Yosĕph, and Nethanyah, and Ashar’ĕlah, the sons of Asaph at the hands of Asaph, who prophesied at the hands of the sovereign.

Of Yeḏuthun, the sons of Yeḏuthun: Geḏalyahu, and Tseri, and Yeshayahu, Ḥashaḇyahu, and Mattithyahu, six, under the hands of their father Yeḏuthun, who prophesied with a lyre to give thanks and to praise יהוה.
Of Hĕman, the sons of Hĕman: Buqqiyahu, Mattanyahu, Uzzi’ĕl, Sheḇu’ĕl, and Yerimoth, Ḥananyah, Ḥanani, Eliyathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-Ezer, Yoshbeqashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Maḥaziyoth.
All these were the sons of Hĕman the sovereign’s seer in the words of Elohim, to exalt his horn. For Elohim gave Hĕman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these were at the hands of their father for song in the House of יהוה, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for the service of the House of Elohim: Asaph, Yeḏuthun, and Hĕman, at the hands of the sovereign.
And the number of them, with their brothers who were taught in the songs of יהוה, all who were skilled, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
And they cast lots for their duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the student.
And the first lot for Asaph came forth for Yosĕph; Geḏalyahu the second, he, and his brothers and sons, twelve;
the third Zakkur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the fourth Yitsri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the fifth Nethanyahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the sixth Buqqiyahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the seventh Yesar’ĕlah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the eighth Yeshayahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the ninth Mattanyahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the tenth Shim‛i, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the eleventh Azar’ĕl, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twelfth Ḥashaḇyah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the thirteenth Shuḇa’ĕl, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the fourteenth Mattithyahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the fifteenth Yerĕmoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the sixteenth Ḥananyahu, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the seventeenth Yoshbeqashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the eighteenth Ḥanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the nineteenth Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twentieth Eliyathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twenty-first Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twenty-second Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twenty-third Maḥaziyoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
the twenty-fourth Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
